doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

chapter: Algiers places, ball games and Frankie Duson
title: Turtle Back Hall and the horse cars
summary: Tom says the Turtle Back Hall is still standing near McDonoghville, where he played, and that horse cars, not buses, ran there.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Where was the Turtle Back Hall? I don't think I ever saw that. Is that still there?
It's still there, around the age of Grittany, I think it was. The Turtle Back Hall, around in Grittany. Yeah.
Up that way. Yeah. It's not in Grittany, but in the... McDonald, what do they call it? McDonald.
Because I used to play in that hall, too. They'd take... We'd rather call it... They had the... Horse cars, didn't I believe? Used to... Toying. Yeah, toying. The hall was right on that side.
They had horse cars. They went up... Yeah.
Place of buses, like they have now.
They didn't have no buses there. They had horse cars. Horse cars.
